Class KasaSmartPlug

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.kasa.KasaSmartPlug
public final class KasaSmartPlug extends Object
Local control and discovery for legacy TP-Link Kasa HS100 and HS110 plugs, over the JDK's own socket classes.

Open a DatagramSocket with openDiscovery() once after Wi-Fi connects, and build a broadcast DatagramPacket with discoveryRequest(byte[]) once. Then broadcastDiscovery(DatagramSocket, DatagramPacket) and poll receiveDiscovery(DatagramSocket, DatagramPacket) for each device's reply: its sender is DatagramPacket.getAddress(), the device's address to pass to turnOn(InetAddress, byte[], byte[], int) or turnOff(InetAddress, byte[], byte[], int). Every buffer belongs to the caller and can be allocated once before the program's main loop. A control command opens a Socket to the device for that one exchange.

    • discoveryRequest

      public static DatagramPacket discoveryRequest(byte[] requestBuffer) throws IOException
      A packet addressed to the local network's broadcast address on PORT, over requestBuffer: the system-information query broadcastDiscovery(DatagramSocket, DatagramPacket) sends with it. Make it once, not in the loop.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • broadcastDiscovery

      public static int broadcastDiscovery(DatagramSocket socket, DatagramPacket request)
      Encrypts the system-information query into request and broadcasts it, returning its length or -1.

    • receiveDiscovery

      public static int receiveDiscovery(DatagramSocket socket, DatagramPacket reply)
      Receives the next discovery reply into reply and decrypts it in place. Returns the JSON payload length, 0 while no reply waits, or -1 for a failed receive or a malformed reply. The device that sent it is DatagramPacket.getAddress().

    • model

      public static int model(byte[] responseBuffer, int responseLength)
      Identifies an HS100 or HS110 from a decrypted discovery or system-information reply. Returns MODEL_UNKNOWN for every other Kasa/Tapo device or malformed input.

    • relayState

      public static int relayState(byte[] responseBuffer, int responseLength)
